sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND InvoiceDate < '2025-04-01 00:00:00';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) AS genre_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId;
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
SELECT LastName, FirstName, HireDate FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';
SELECT AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'Protected AAC audio file';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 13.86;
SELECT COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge';
